note: Wire table image-read at 300 dpi from printed p.6 (PDF p.12): the page prints 26 wires, a sixth column holding only 5F/5-, which the circuit drawing also shows (5F to 5-). The pdftotext layer drops that column, so programs.json wiresPrinted (25) is a transcription defect, not a manual defect; this fixture carries the printed 26. No errata entry. Pushbuttons 2 and 3 are not pushed (printed steps 2-3); their light-OFF expects follow step 1. Expects assert only the relay lights the page names, never the relay armatures or the worked 10011 pattern as a whole. Steps 4-5 print 'Push pushbutton N' without 'and release'; the release follows step 1's 'Push pushbutton 1 and release' (the same 'transmit a "one"' action), and each light-ON expect is taken after release, where 'is being remembered' applies.
